sources.title: GitHub - lab260ru/AASIST3
sources.snippet: AASIST3 is an enhanced version of the AASIST (Anti-spoofing with Adaptive Softmax and Instance-wise Temperature) architecture that incorporates Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for improved speech deepfake detection.
